records.translation_ar: غياب رسالة وحدة التحكم بالهيكل BCM
records.definition_evidence: Definition quoted in listed manufacturer TSB; distinct from general SAE semantics
symptoms: Dynamic/DNA driving mode selector may not work
MIL may illuminate; active engine MIL can itself disable DNA selector

possible_causes.cause: DSCM calibration/software fault on bulletin-covered VIN
Loss of BCM-to-DSCM messages or malfunctioning selector wiring/rotary encoder, if persistent after official procedure

diagnostic_steps: Save DSCM and BCM codes as active/stored and check whether an engine MIL is active
Verify model, build date and VIN against 08-020-21; inspect selector operation after OEM power reset procedure
If the bulletin is applicable, use the OEM-calibrated DSCM software procedure; no arbitrary module swap
Clear DTCs and test DNA modes; if still faulty follow matched wiring fault tree

electrical.reason: OEM VIN-specific electrical evidence not supplied

records.market_sweden: Not individually confirmed; only EMEA included for DSCM bulletin, others North America or LATAM

records.definition_en: Ignition Coil A Primary Control Circuit Low
records.translation_ar: انخفاض إشارة دائرة التحكم الأولية لملف الإشعال A
records.definition_evidence: Definition quoted in listed manufacturer TSB; distinct from general SAE semantics
symptoms: MIL may illuminate
Potential misfire/rough running if electrical coil fault is real

possible_causes.cause: PCM software issue on bulletin-covered 2023 Stelvio EC2
Actual coil primary circuit, power supply, connector, harness or PCM driver issue remains possible

diagnostic_steps: Save PCM freeze frame and all misfire/coil DTC statuses
Confirm EC2 engine sales code, VIN and calibration; check official RSU status
Before replacing coils, inspect low-voltage ignition coil supply and connectors against VIN wiring diagram
If eligible, perform official PCM flash and required re-learn/proxy functions, then clear faults and validate under safe test conditions
tools: Multimeter only with correct safe diagnostic procedure

electrical.reason: OEM VIN-specific electrical evidence not supplied

records.market_sweden: Not individually confirmed; only EMEA included for DSCM bulletin, others North America or LATAM

records.definition_evidence: Definition quoted in listed manufacturer TSB; distinct from general SAE semantics
symptoms: MIL, driveability concerns or irregular running possible

possible_causes.cause: PCM software fault on covered 2017–2018 Giulia EC2
Actual MAP/BARO sensor plausibility, manifold air leaks, sensor connector, supply or ground fault

diagnostic_steps: Confirm P0106-00, record freeze frame and engine sales code EC2
Compare MAP with BARO and related sensor pressures at key-on engine-off using VIN OEM specifications
Inspect intake leakage and connector corrosion; do not infer fixed voltage or pinout
Check revised ECM calibration applicability, BCM/TCM supporting software, and authorized proxy/routine as required
Re-read DTC and verify consistent pressure sensor plausibility
